entities.description: Thief who joked of a lost conscience.

entities.description: Necromancer who commands the Kjeldoran Dead.

entities.description: Speaker of last words about the lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Mi'cha
entities.description: Figure who flung a drunken soldier over ten meters.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Fears the Homelands are lost without Feroz's Ban.

entities.name: Thrulls

entities.name: Serra Paladins
entities.description: Order with a vow of one light, one blade, one purpose.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: Land whose self-proclaimed queen is Nailah.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Place where Feldon found a cane.

entities.name: Fyndhorn
entities.description: Home of the Elvish Council and druids.

entities.description: Battle that taught Urza not to rely on reinforcements.

entities.name: Battle of Sarinth

events.summary: Calmont notes that one's word as law makes one's whim binding.
events.quote: "When one's word is law, one's whim is equally binding."

events.summary: Ailis Connaut writes in her diary that Icatia could not be saved but children were given time.
events.quote: "In these, our final days, I offer this. Though we could not save Icatia, we gave our children time to grow, and love, before it fell."

events.summary: The Icatian phalanxes hold their ranks even after the wall is breached.
events.quote: Even after the wall was breached in half a dozen places, the phalanxes fought on

events.summary: Icatia's towns become armed camps by the time the empire falls.
events.quote: By the time the empire fell, they were little more than armed camps.

events.summary: Jolrael regrets feeding Kaervek's hunger for power.
events.quote: "I regret feeding Kaervek's hunger for power—far better to live with animals innocent of such ambitions."

events.summary: Justina casts a great spell on her weapons as evil ones approach, fulfilling a prophecy.
events.quote: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force.

events.summary: Tross's expedition sees Belfar leave palmprints on an icy wall.
events.quote: We had no choice but to pull his hands free from where he had touched it, leaving flesh palmprints on the icy wall."

events.summary: Hurkyl did the work that was credited to Drafna.
events.quote: This spell, like many attributed to Drafna, was actually the work of his wife and former student, Hurkyl.

events.summary: Nethya stiffens and falls lifeless.
events.quote: Nethya stiffened suddenly, head cocked as if straining to hear some distant sound, then fell lifeless to the ground.

events.summary: Thrulls overwhelm the Order of the Ebon Hand.
events.quote: The thrulls bred at a terrifying pace. In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

events.summary: Baron Sengir speaks to Autumn Willow about forests of corpses; she answers about fallen trees nourishing seedlings.
events.quote: "Every forest is carpeted with the corpses of a thousand trees."

events.summary: Lim-Dûl speaks of the Kjeldoran Dead killing those they loved.
events.quote: They shall kill those whom once they loved."

events.summary: Lim-Dûl binds himself to Leshrac.
events.quote: Blood for blood, flesh for flesh, Leshrac, my lord."

events.summary: Necrites killed Jherana Rure, ending the counterinsurgency.
events.quote: Necrites killed Jherana Rure, ending the counterinsurgency.

events.summary: The alliance of Balduvia and Kjeldor forces Stromgald agents to fuel rituals with their own flesh.
events.quote: When the alliance between Balduvia and Kjeldor deprived Stromgald of easy victories, its agents were forced to fuel their rituals with their own flesh.

events.summary: Thrulls served faithfully until the Rebellion.
events.quote: "Until the Rebellion, thrulls served their masters faithfully—even at the cost of their own lives."

events.summary: Nailah, self-proclaimed Queen of Rabiah, threatens a victim.
events.quote: "We have always counted time with sand; this pinch is your meaningless life."

events.summary: Avram Garrisson calls on Stromgald to claim blood-watered fields.
events.quote: for glory, and for Stromgald!"

events.summary: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog and a line of goblin predecessors.
events.quote: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok . . . .

events.summary: Lagfrak the Low terrorizes the countryside until he meets Il-Chunt.
events.quote: With the horrible mask, Lagfrak the Low terrorized the countryside.

events.summary: Fergo reaps the benefits of strength after years of bullying.
events.quote: After years of being bullied, Fergo reaped the benefits of his newfound strength

events.summary: Harthag laughs at the army before him.
events.quote: Harthag gave a jolly laugh as he surveyed the army before him.

events.summary: Harthar attacks a force of nature and dies like falling petals.
events.quote: Harthar, sensing weakness, attacked—and his blood fell like petals."

events.summary: Kolbjörn is quoted on foxfire.
events.quote: "Only the foolish fear foxfire."

events.summary: Saffi Eriksdotter shouts a warning about the lhurgoyf as her last words.
events.quote: "Ach! Hans, run! It's the lhurgoyf!"

events.summary: Ivra Jursdotter recalls an ogre turning on its commander.
events.quote: "We were holding our own—until the ogre guiding us suddenly grinned and turned on our commander."

events.summary: Urza gains the people of Kroog as allies and gives healers amulets.
events.quote: Among the first allies Urza gained were the people of Kroog.

events.summary: Tawnos cracks the puzzle of Mishra's structures.
events.quote: Tawnos finally cracked the puzzle: the strange structures did not house Mishra's malevolent creations but were themselves among his creations.

events.summary: The Brothers' War scarred the land, and Ashnod marked bloodlines.
events.quote: The Brothers' War scarred the land, but Ashnod left her mark in the bloodlines of those she tortured.

events.summary: Ashnod finds few willing to trade humanity for power.
events.quote: Ashnod found few willing to trade their humanity for the power she offered.

events.summary: Barl's Cage weakens as Mairsil's power fades, releasing Lord Ith.
events.quote: For a dozen years the cage had held Lord Ith, but as the Pretender Mairsil's power weakened, so did the bars.

events.summary: Mishra's defeat teaches mages not to rely on walls.
events.quote: By the time Mishra was defeated, no mage was foolish enough to rely heavily on walls.

events.summary: Urza promotes Tawnos directly to master after the Clay Statue warriors.
events.quote: After he created these warriors, Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

events.summary: Mishra speaks of legged engines being born not made.
events.quote: "How is it the legged engines seem so much more alive than their wheeled counterparts? Simply, they were born, not made."

events.summary: Research suggests Tocasia invented the Grapeshot Catapult used by both brothers.
events.quote: Recent research suggests these creatures were invented by Urza's and Mishra's original master, Tocasia, and that both brothers used them.

events.summary: The Battle of Tomakul teaches Urza not to rely on reinforcements.
events.quote: The Battle of Tomakul taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

events.summary: Urza improves on Thran's ornithopter design.
events.quote: "It has been my honor to improve on Thran's original design.

events.summary: Urza decides to create one versatile being.
events.quote: Unable to settle on just one design, Urza decided to create one versatile being.

events.summary: Peasant-pikemen hold off craw wurms at the Battle of Sarinth.
events.quote: during which a handful of peasant-pikemen held off a trio of rampaging craw wurms.

events.summary: Daria fears the Homelands are lost without Feroz's Ban.
events.quote: "Without the protection of Feroz's Ban, I fear the Homelands are lost."

events.summary: Tawnos's weaponry replaces costly war machines.
events.quote: When war machines became too costly, Tawnos's weaponry replaced them.

relations.quote: Tawnos won fame as Urza's greatest assistant.
